uncertainty: The mutex serializes complete runtime rounds and compiler pairs. Other builds or processes can still contend; one CPU idle check per runtime round and bounded waits provide evidence rather than continuous machine isolation.

gate_granularity.runtime: One complete 13-case round, each case before then after, per acquisition; five fresh rounds; idle check once per complete round
gate_granularity.compile: One archetype fixture before/after pair per acquisition
gate_granularity.direct_clang: Original completed pairs retained; remaining paired rounds use one finishing acquisition, with CPU idle checks before each pair.

previous_partial_diagnostics.note: Earlier partial samples with the same final labels are preserved as historical diagnostics, including imported baseline samples. Dates before reference_cutoff_utc are excluded from fresh reference_records.

continuation.reason: Cooperative public Runspace.Close stopped the original runner while it waited for the benchmark gate; consolidate remaining direct compiler pairs into one acquisition.
continuation.gate: One benchmark mutex acquisition for all remaining complete before/after pairs; CPU idle check before every pair.
